notes.title: Progress Update: for Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
Since we have been too silent about the updates, we are here to show you stuffs we are currently working on!

[h2]New Mode![/h2]
An entirely new mode [b]Line Score Challenge[/b] is under development!
This mode does not have any time limitation, but instead, you race to the target "Line Score", which you can get by completing multiple lines at once. Here's what it looks like now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454676/d5d8b4e35e2d7624bc0657979d6f39cfeee443ac.png[/img]

[h2]Difficulty Selection[/h2]
The current difficulty curve is such that difficult-to-place pieces start appearing as the level goes up (or the level is fixed depending on the mode). However, we have found that pentominos, which are pieces consisting of 5 blocks, are disproportionately difficult to drop and fill the board. To address this issue, we're working on changing what pentominos are allowed to spawn by adding a 'difficulty' feature! This means that the leaderboard will be split into multiple difficulties. The current leaderboards are scheduled to be preserved, but which difficulty they are assigned to is to be determined.

[h2]Game pad Support!![/h2]
We haven't forgotten the game pad support! We are starting with DualSense controllers. Here's the sneak peek of how the control might look like with game pad connected:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454676/7e21957dc37a655cb907b5f1a30e0e5f4ddbd941.png[/img]

Rest assurred, we are also expanding the game pad support beyond DualSense controllers!

Just a heads-up that this game’s being made (and fixed) by one person after hours, so those updates are taking time. Thanks for understanding, and I appreciate all the feedback!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We appreciate your patience!! Drop 'n' Fill! Version 1.2.0 is now live! Here are what this update mainly covers:

[h2]Achievements![/h2]
Achievements are now available for you to unlock! Try clearing lines, get better grades in Timed Mode... Try various things!
(Please note that some of the achievements shown on the store page are still under development and are not unlockable. This is due to a technical limitation. Please sit tight for more achievements to come!)

[h2]Updated the Groove![/h2]
We [b][i]completely[/i][/b] borked the groove in 1.1.0... That's why we updated our sound system to the latest shiny version! Not only the BGM issue should be gone now, but also your input will produce subtle changes to the BGM. Try placing blocks, and clearing lines, and hear them for yourself!!

notes.title: About the next update
notes.content: We're sorry to announce that the update that was coming this week has to be pushed back a bit. We hit an unforeseen game development issue that surfaced only when we attempted to create an executable file. The root cause is likely determined and we're working hard to fix it, so please sit tight for the achievements and improvements to the audio experience!!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 Exhibition of Drop 'n' Fill! is Over!
notes.content:
[h1]Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 Exhibition of Drop 'n' Fill! is Over![/h1]

Thank you for trying our game at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7!
We had 5 hours to exhibit our game, during which there were a whopping 70 playthroughs!! There are some glitches that were found at the event, and we will address them in the updates! Stay tuned!

[h1]The sale is still on![/h1]

The launch sale is still on! It's a two-week sale, so don't miss it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394980/Drop_n_Fill/

------------

[h2]Known issues and planned features[/h2]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game softlocks if the 'start' button is spammed
[*] The cutout mask in the tutorial is sometimes in an unintended position, leading to confusion
[*] The "STUCK!" message overlaps the skill description window
[/list]

[h3]Balance-releated issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Time attack mode currently gives you a 0 (F rank) as your rank point if you get totally stuck before the time is up. This behaviour will change.
[list]
[*] Instead, you will receive a heavily penalised rank point.
[/list]
[*] Currently, all possible pentominoes can appear equally in the game, but this makes a playthrough a bit tough. We'll add a difficulty option where you can choose which set of pentominoes to appear. (For example, only the "stick" and a "big corner" would appear if you choose the "casual" difficulty)
[/list]

[h3]Planned features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] More musical grooves synced to your playthrough
[/list]
